title: Background handler registered inside a component, plus three chain breaks
notes: Four defects along the delivery chain, and the reported symptom ('works open, not closed') points straight at the first. (1) setBackgroundMessageHandler is inside a useEffect, so it does not exist when the app is killed — the exact case it is for. It must be at module scope in index.js. (2) api.post is not awaited and has no error handling, so a failed token write is invisible and that device silently never receives push. (3) No onTokenRefresh, so tokens rotate and delivery decays over time. (4) getInitialNotification is absent, so a tap on a killed app opens the home screen and loses the intent — and msg.data.deepLink is passed to navigate unvalidated. Also worth flagging: permission is requested on mount, which spends the one iOS prompt at the worst moment. Tests whether the agent walks the chain rather than reading the code top to bottom.
